nist_workbook: /oak/stanford/groups/gorle/jgoell/Wildfire/eki_calibration/../ParameterEstimationFiles/NIST_TN2135_AppendixF/NIST TN 2135 Appendix F Fire Spread Data.xlsx
time_rule: model_t_s = report start time (PST) - t0; equals elapsed + ignition_s (origin 2018-11-08T06:15:00 PST = ignition); window_end_s = model_t_s + 60 * NIST Obs Window (min)
in_window: ignition_s < model_t_s <= stop_s; window_end_after_stop flags windows that end later
event_type: residual = NIST Residual Fire? x (after the front); fire_present = any other report (fire observed at the place during the window: an upper bound on arrival)
match: feature i = located workbook row i, accepted only because every pair agrees exactly on lon, lat (6 decimals), day and minute
eligible: surface-burnable fuel model, or fuel 91 with building area > 0 (fixed landscape)
mapping: direct: containing cell eligible; proxy: nonburnable containing cell, nearest eligible cell centre to the reported point within the radius (ties: lower row, then column); excluded: none within the radius, outside the domain, or excluded on review; review: containing fuel in review_fuels [92, 93, 98, 99] without a recorded decision
